PRODUCT DESIGN · EDTECH · 2026

The Student App
built like a world worth logging into.

A case study on Alpha+, the companion app for Alpha College — turning timetables, attendance and academic life into one connected, game-like experience.

ClientAlpha College
StudioSKONZS
FounderSyed Maaz Hussaini
PlatformWeb · Mobile
LEVEL 01

One app for everything a student juggles.

Alpha+ brings academic information and student activity into a single organised platform — schedules, attendance, courses, sessions and community — so students spend less time hunting for information and more time using it.

Information, scattered.Timetables, assignments, attendance and announcements lived across group chats, notice boards and separate portals — students needed a single source of truth.

Admin over-head, daily.Checking attendance percentage, booking a tutor, or finding a room number each took a separate app or a walk to the office.

Low emotional pull.Academic tools rarely make students want to open them twice — utility without motivation.

Core modules shipped10
Onboarding flowsSign up · Sign in
Design languageDark, ember-lit UI
Signature systemLevels, XP & streaks
Attendance floor tracked75% honours cutoff
LEVEL 02

Design a campus that feels earned, not administered.

Instead of another grey admin portal, Alpha+ borrows the language of the worlds students already spend time in — levels, streaks, ranks and quests — and points every one of those mechanics at a real academic outcome: showing up, submitting on time, and staying on top of grades.

LEVEL 03

The ecosystem

The dashboard sits at the centre as the daily command post; every other module orbits it at a distance that reflects how often a student reaches for it.

Courses — GPA & progress tracking
Attendance — live presence overview
Timetable — weekly class quest log
Sessions — academic, career & wellness booking
Chat — peer & study-group messaging
Ranking — house & academic leaderboard
Profile — digital ID, streaks & badges
Fees & Quizzes — billing and quick tests

LEVEL 05

Colour theory

Ember and crimson sit close together on the wheel — an analogous pair that reads as one warm family rather than two competing accents. Green is borrowed only for a functional job: progress and success states.

Parchment on Ink AAA · 16.1:1
Mist on Panel AA · 5.4:1
Ink on Ember AA · 6.2:1
Ink on Parchment AAA · 15.4:1
Ink 60%
Parchment 30%
Ember 10%
The 60–30–10 rule as applied across the product: dominant dark surface, secondary light panels, and a disciplined 10% reserved for the accent so every ember touch still reads as an action.

LEVEL 07

The product, screen by screen

Every flow below solves one real student moment — from the first sign-up to checking a rank on the leaderboard.

01 · ONBOARDING

Getting in

A warm coral-on-black welcome sets the tone before a student ever sees the dashboard — separate paths for current students and new applicants keep the form short for each.

Sign in
Single-column form, Google & Apple SSO, and a full-bleed portrait that carries the brand's illustrated identity.
Sign up
A role toggle — Current Student / New Applicant — branches the form early so each audience only fills in what applies to them.
02 · HOME BASE

The dashboard

Attendance, average score and global rank sit above the fold, followed by eight quick actions and the day's schedule — the one screen a student should never need to leave twice.

Dashboard
Streaks (academic, prayer, login, attendance) sit beside the schedule, rewarding consistency in more than one dimension of student life.
03 · LEARNING CORE

Courses, timetable & attendance

Three views of the same academic data, each answering a different question: what's due, what's next, and am I still on track.

My Courses
GPA banner up top, per-course progress bars and pending-assignment counts below.
Timetable
Day / Week / Month toggle keeps the same schedule readable at any zoom level.
Attendance
A calendar heat-view plus a course-wise breakdown against the 75% honours threshold.
Course-wise detail
Drilling into one course keeps the same calendar language — present, absent, today — for a consistent mental model across the app.
04 · SUPPORT

Booking a session

Academic, career and wellness appointments live under one roof, with a counsellor picker and live time-slot calendar so booking takes under thirty seconds.

Sessions
Three categories up top, upcoming sessions on the right — nothing is more than two taps from view.
Book a session
Counsellor, date and slot on one screen — unavailable times are greyed out rather than hidden, so the calendar stays trustworthy.
05 · COMMUNITY

Chat & the leaderboard

The social layer turns quiet academic effort into something visible — a place to ask a classmate a question, and a place to see how that effort ranks.

Chat
Direct messages and a class-wide study group in one inbox, with lecturer messages visually distinct from peers.
Hall of Fame
A podium for the top three, a scrollable list below, and the current student's own rank pinned to the bottom — always visible, never buried.
06 · IDENTITY

The student profile

Part transcript, part trophy case — verified exam results sit next to badges, pets and streaks, giving students a profile worth showing a friend.

Profile
A digital ID pass, verified certificate download, and a teacher endorsement quote anchor the page in real academic credibility.
LEVEL 08

Academic life, made worth logging into.

Alpha+ shows that an academic tool doesn't have to feel like paperwork — borrowing the mechanics students already understand from games, and pointing them at attendance, grades and community instead.
